description: Rete GNSS Puglia is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by gps.sit.puglia.it. Network of Permanent Stations Global Navigation System (GNSS) of the Region of Puglia. The network, composed of 12 permanent stations, has been included in the national geodetic framework systemETRF2000-RDN.Six stations of the network are part of the National Dynamics Network of the IGM. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "GNSS Apulia Network" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
